patch_description: Crossover of the two soft-min/soft-max L-BFGS optimizers. Combines the current program's staged beta escalation (20→60→150) on the unit sphere with the inspiration's clean free-space refinement, and adds: (a) a larger diverse seed pool with early exit, (b) free-space refinement at increasing sharpness (60→150→400), (c) greedy perturbation polish around the best configuration re-optimized at high beta. The true (dmin/dmax)^2 score is used to accept candidates, so improvements are only kept when they actually raise the metric. Precompute triu indices once for speed. Fixed seeds ensure reproducibility.
